title: Social Services Legislation Amendment (Overseas Welfare Recipients Integrity Program) Bill 2019
short_title: Social Services Legislation Amendment (Overseas Welfare Recipients Integrity Program) Bill 2019

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would require certain pension recipients aged 80 or older who have been continuously overseas for at least two years to provide proof-of-life certificates.
Recipients would have 13 weeks to respond to a notice, with certificates checked in person by authorised certifiers and notices issued at least biennially.
Failure to comply could suspend and then cancel payments, while returning to Australia within the initial response period would remove the certificate requirement.
changes: New certificate requirements would begin on 1 July 2019.
Compliant evidence could permit payment to resume, including arrears under the applicable review rules.
Wife Pension and Widow B Pension provisions would be removed from 20 March 2020 to reflect those payments’ scheduled closure.
summary.affected: Eligible overseas recipients of Age Pension, Disability Support Pension, Carer Payment, Wife Pension and Widow B Pension are affected.
